judged_text: removeMember and addMembers attach only a .then that reloads the member list, with no .catch; a 422 (e.g. can_not_modify_automatic) or network failure leaves the UI showing the pre-operation member list with no feedback. An admin clicks remove/add on a group whose mutation is rejected; bootbox confirm closed, no error rendered, list unchanged — the user-facing operation fails invisibly.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js`, both `addMembers` and `removeMember` return `Discourse.ajax(...).then(function() { self.findMembers(); })` and do not attach any rejection handling. In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `actions.removeMember` and `actions.addMembers` call these methods without handling promise failures either, so this code path provides no local UI feedback on request failure (whether via network error or a 4xx/5xx). However, the finding’s specific 422 example for `can_not_modify_automatic` is less grounded because the templates hide add/remove UI for automatic groups (`{{#unless automatic}} ... {{/unless}}` in `group.hbs` and `group_member.hbs`).
